reason: The cited evidence shows that HEAs can catalyze a 12-electron ethanol oxidation (E2) and that multi-element nanoparticles improve EOR activity and durability (E3), but none of the passages provide specific support for the claimed mechanism of d-band center tuning, heterogeneous active site distribution, or optimized adsorption energies. E2 even questions the applicability of d-band center theory to HEAs, and E1 concerns mesoporous Pd, not HEAs.
premises: HEA structures create heterogeneous active sites via local distortions and d-band shifts
These sites optimize adsorption/desorption of ethanol and intermediates
Optimized binding prevents surface poisoning and enhances durability
Alloying PGM with non-PGM metals tunes the d-band center
